abstract: Audits active cargo compartment environmental control and transport vehicle specifications
system_message:
You are the Fleet Operations Manager (FOM), responsible for auditing active cargo compartment environmental control and transport vehicle specifications across candidate biobank relocation carrier plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Audits active cargo compartment environmental control and transport vehicle specifications（FLEET）
information_points.content:
FOM-FLEET-3VE：For the Boreal Specimen Express Protocol, pre-dispatch engineering sign-off confirms that climate-controlled cargo verification is satisfied, ensuring secondary HVAC maintains temperatures below 15 degrees Celsius across the primary cargo hold envelope.
FOM-FLEET-3K5：For the Apex CryoLogistics Cold-Chain Matrix, pre-dispatch engineering sign-off confirms that climate-controlled cargo verification is satisfied, with secondary HVAC maintaining temperatures below 15 degrees Celsius in the primary cargo hold envelope.
FOM-FLEET-XIT：For the Polaris Biovault Ground Transit System, pre-dispatch engineering sign-off indicates that climate-controlled cargo verification is not satisfied for maintaining cargo hold temperatures below 15 degrees Celsius.

information_points.title: Vehicle Telematics Tracking（TELE）
information_points.content:
FOM-TELE-YTQ：According to the fleet telematics dashboard, the GPS polling frequency for all assigned escort units in the Polaris Biovault Ground Transit System is 30 s.
FOM-TELE-IQU：According to the fleet telematics dashboard, the GPS polling frequency for all assigned escort units in the Apex CryoLogistics Cold-Chain Matrix is 60 s.
FOM-TELE-6P0：According to the fleet telematics dashboard, the GPS polling frequency for all assigned escort units in the Boreal Specimen Express Protocol is 15 s.
